subject: FinOptics - per-token usage forensics & discount reconciliation
messages:
From: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@finoptics.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-01T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: granular usage export + commit discount reconciliation

Hi Lauren / Aditya,

We're preparing our month-end reconciliation and need a detailed per-token usage export to reconcile charges against our committed tiers. Specifically can you provide: 
- CSV with daily token counts split by direction (prompt vs completion) and by API endpoint (chat/generate/embeddings)
- Model-level attribution (gpt-4-esque vs gpt-like open models) and per-token price used to compute invoice line items
- Any automatic discounts applied (commit tier, volume thresholds, promo credits) and how those were allocated across line items

We raised this because our AP team saw a charge in April that looks higher than expected for embeddings — want to confirm whether embedding tokens were billed under the Gen bucket or as a separate line item.

Can you produce the export and a short mapping table (line item key -> explanation) by EOD Monday, May 3? If useful, we can schedule a quick 20-minute call.

Thanks,
Liam O'Connell
Head of Cloud Ops, FinOptics
liam.oconnell@finoptics.com
+1 415 555 0198
From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@finoptics.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-01T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: granular usage export + commit discount reconciliation

Hi Liam — thanks for the clear ask. We can do this. Quick clarifications so we deliver exactly what you need:
- For "prompt vs completion" do you want the raw token counts or the normalized token units we use internally (we can provide both; raw is what was logged at runtime)
- For model attribution, we will include model name + family + quantization variant used (if any). Is it critical to separate open-model vs. Redwood-verified models?
- When you mention "promo credits" do you mean one-off credits we granted last quarter (DO-91211) or automatic commit discounts? We will flag both separately.

Next steps: Aditya will drop the raw export (CSV) and a short mapping legend here. Vanessa will attach the pricing matrix that shows how commit tiers map to per-token discounts. If that looks right we can reclassify embedding tokens into a dedicated line item on the next invoice — we'll need your AP person to confirm acceptance for accounting.

If you want a call, how about Monday 11:00 PT?

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Office: +1 650 555 0224

On Mon, May 1, 2027 at 2:12 PM Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@finoptics.com> wrote:
> We're preparing our month-end reconciliation and need a detailed per-token usage export to reconcile charges against our committed tiers...
From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-02T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: granular usage export + commit discount reconciliation

Hi team — attached is the raw export CSV (usage_export_202703.csv) generated from our billing pipeline. A few notes on columns:
- date (UTC), customer_id, api_endpoint (chat/generate/embeddings), model_name, direction (prompt/completion), tokens_raw, tokens_normalized, unit_price_applied_cents, discount_code_applied
- unit_price_applied_cents reflects the per-token price *after* commit discounts and any prorated promos
- discount_code_applied will be empty when no discount/commit was matched; when present it's the internal discount id (e.g., COMMIT-DO-98342)

Open items:
1) We currently map embeddings to the embeddings line item when the request used the embeddings endpoint, otherwise embeddings tokens that were processed as part of a chat/generate call are included on the gen line item. If you want all embedding tokens aggregated to a dedicated line item regardless of endpoint, we can re-run the mapping and issue invoice reclassification for April (requires AP sign-off).
2) For older sessions where model aliasing changed (we renamed some open-model aliases in March) we included an alias_map.csv; let us know if you want the pre-rename breakdown.

I'll leave it to Lauren/Vanessa to draft the short human-readable mapping for AP to ingest.

— Aditya
Senior Billing Engineer, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai

Attached: usage_export_202703.csv (CSV, 2.3 MB)
From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@finoptics.com>, Finance Team <billing@finoptics.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-02T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: granular usage export + commit discount reconciliation

Hi Liam / FinOptics AP team —

Thanks for the patience. Attached is a brief package: 1) raw CSV export (from Aditya), 2) a two-page mapping "line item glossary" that explains each invoice key and how discounts were applied, and 3) our current pricing matrix showing commit tiers and the discount ladder (redwood_pricing_matrix_v3.pdf).

Summary highlights:
- April overage explanation: ~78% of the unexpected delta came from a batch of high-embedding-volume jobs that were routed to the embeddings endpoint and billed under the embeddings line item, but a smaller portion (~22%) were embedding tokens embedded in chat sessions and therefore billed under the gen line. We show both in the CSV so you can re-aggregate however you prefer.
- Discounts: COMMIT-DO-98342 was applied on 2027-04-01 onward; the per-token rate in the CSV already reflects that credit. We also show a one-time promo credit (DO-91211) applied on 2027-04-03 as a separate negative line in the ledger.
- Reclassification: If you want us to move the chat-embedded tokens into a dedicated embedding line item for accounting, we can reclassify April and issue a corrected invoice. That requires a written AP confirmation to billing@redwood.ai.

Next steps / asks for you:
1) Please confirm whether you want reclassification for April (reply to billing@redwood.ai).
2) If you accept the proposed mapping, we'll provide a cleaned CSV with a single "billing_line_item" column ready for ingestion into your GL.
3) If you'd like, we've tentatively scheduled a 20-minute call Monday 11:00 PT to walk through the package — confirm if that works.

Links: HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/FinOptics
DocuSign (if needed for adjusted invoice): https://app.docusign.com/1234-abc-5678

Regards,
Lauren Bishop
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood_pricing_matrix_v3.pdf (PDF, 420 KB); usage_export_202703.csv (CSV, 2.3 MB)
